title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Financial Consumer Protection Digital Scam Prevention and Cyber Fraud Bill
objective: Ensure 5-day bank customer reimbursement for reported cyber fraud and eliminate illegal loan apps.

indicators.name: Cyber Fraud 5-Day Bank Reimbursement Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of reported unauthorized digital fraud claims reimbursed by banks within 5 working days.

oversight.composition: RBI representatives, judges, cyber forensic experts, consumer advocates
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and bank reimbursement enforcement

complaints.channel: National Cyber Fraud Reporting Portal & Helpline (1930)

triggers.condition: Failure of a bank to reimburse an unauthorized fraud victim within 5 working days.
triggers.detector: RBI National Cyber Fraud Portal Alerts
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory temporary credit order against defaulting bank
triggers.correction: Penalty release and bank compliance directive
